rows.grounds: instrumental of compound mahiṣa-aśva-purīṣa (buffalo, horse, dung)

items.question: Which additional substances are required to inscribe the written name?
premises: The inscription procedure continues from the previously stated method.
Buffalo and horse dung is specified as a writing substance.
Cow urine is specified as an additional writing substance.
items.inference: The written name should be inscribed using buffalo-horse dung together with cow urine.
items.plain_english: One should inscribe it with buffalo and horse dung and with cow urine.
